title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00024 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
18:30 - 20:00: Prepared to skid cantilever
20:00 - 20:30: Performed pre-job meeting to skid cantilever
20:30 - 21:00: Removed stairs and bridge to cantilever
21:00 - 21:45: Skidded cantilever to f-12 slot, 0. 5m to port 4. 56m forward and 0. 5m to starboard
21:45 - 23:45: Removed moon pool hatch on f-12 and confirmed cantilever position. Installed split hatches on f-12
23:45 - 00:00: Performed pre-job meeting for rigging up wire line equipment in moon pool and drill floor
